meta: Writing a task prompt for an AI agent: agents usually go wrong because the brief is vague. A good brief has three parts.

muc.title: A vague brief
muc.text: Agents usually go wrong because the brief is vague. A good brief has three parts: the goal, the limits, and when to ask back.

muc.title: Describe the result
muc.text: The goal is a concrete result, like a table comparing five restaurants near the office, with prices and opening hours.

muc.title: Draw the lines
muc.text: Limits are what it must not do, like no booking and no going over budget.

muc.title: When to stop and ask
muc.text: Finally, tell the agent to stop and ask you when information is missing or when it needs to log in.

muc.title: Write all three parts
muc.text: Write a three-part brief for a small task, then ask a chatbot to point out what's still vague.
